title: ononis repens f. inermis
intro: Ononis repens f. inermis, commonly known as Restharrow, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the Fabaceae family. The plant is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to treat skin conditions such as eczema and dermatitis, as well as its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Restharrow include its antiseptic and antimicrobial properties, which help to soothe and protect the skin. The bioactive constituents of Restharrow include flavonoids and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
